lee: FYI deploybot halted stable promotion for 2026.03.21-stable. Reason: attestation missing on replicated image in us-east-1 ECR. Happens during cross-region replication. :flag-us:

taylor: any logs from the registry side?

lee: snippet from publish job: ```
[publish-job] pushing image: app-service:2026.03.21-stable
[replicator] replicate to us-east-1: success (blob upload)
[replicator] replicate attestation: failure -> 404 NotFound: attestation not found for digest sha256:ff12aa33
[release-check] deploybot: expected attestation present: false
```

deploybot: Promotion blocked  reason: missing-cosign-attestation (region: us-east-1). Auto-hold engaged. See /releases/2026.03.21. To unhold, provide attestation digest or `@deploybot unhold 1793334200` with justification.

nina: This is the replication TTL ordering race. The attestation can lag the blob replication. Two mitigations: 1) republish the attestation object to the destination registry, or 2) pin the stable route to the source-region digest so stable continues until attestation replicates.

ops-oncall: Pinning sounds lower-risk in the short window. If we pin, what's rollback criteria?

lee: Rollback criteria if pinned canary/stable causes >1% 5xxs for 5m or p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline. If that happens, revert route to prev-digest and rerun attestation publish.

lee: Proposed immediate steps: 
- ops pin stable to digest sha256:ff12aa33 in routing (temporary)
- schedule attestation republish job from the publish-orchestrator to run at 15:45 UTC (change window) targeting us-east-1 mirror
- after attestation exists, unhold by `@deploybot unhold 1793334200` and remove pin

taylor: I can run the republish job manually if the orchestrator fails. Quick commands: ```
# copy attestation blob to dest registry (example)
aws s3 cp s3://attestations/sha256_ff12aa33.json ./att.json
cosign attest --key ksm://projects/xxxx --artifact sha256:ff12aa33 --predicate ./att.json --repository us-east-1.dkr.ecr.amazonaws.com/my-repo
```

nina: Also add a short-term CI gate: after replication, check `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name my-repo --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:ff12aa33` and `aws ecr describe-image-scan-findings` (or our attestation check) before hitting deploybot unhold.

ops-oncall: I'm going to add a release_notes entry: "2026.03.21 - stable promotion held in us-east-1 due to attestation replication lag; stable pinned to source digest; attestation republish scheduled; follow-up: replication observability added to CI."

lee: I'll open the routing PR to pin to digest now and kick the republish job in 10m. Ping here when done.

deploybot: Hold created by deploybot at 1793334200. Current state: HOLD. Recorded action items: pin digest, republish attestation, monitor metrics, unhold when attestation present.
